messages.author: 195a5e75ebedb149
messages.subject: getAllNodeAttributes
parts:
Dear RCytoscape users

I can't get the RCy function 'getAllNodeAttributes(Cy_Wind)' to work.
I am trying on a cytosape file that I previously saved and reopened,
and other commands are working. The error is:

Error in function (classes, fdef, mtable) :
unable to find an inherited method for function "nodeData" for
signature "graphNEL, "character", NULL

There is in fact data in the node attributes, but there are blank
spaces in some cells. Does anyone else have this problem?

Thanks

Mark Grimes

messages.author: 195a5e75ebedb149
messages.subject: Re: getAllNodeAttributes
parts:
Further testing uncovers the source of my problem and reveals something that may be a bug, or something I am not understanding about creating new sub-network windows :

cw2 <- existing.CytoscapeWindow (cywindname,  copy.graph.from.cytoscape.to.R=TRUE)
node.atts2 <- getAllNodeAttributes(cw2)  # this works! 
g2 = getGraph (cw2)
test2=nodeData(g2)  # okay 

# but not this
subW <- createWindowFromSelection (w2, childname, return.graph=TRUE)
node.atts3 <- getAllNodeAttributes(subW)  # doesn't work after createWindowFromSelection;  error message:
#Error in function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
#  unable to find an inherited method for function "nodeData", for signature "graphNEL", "character", "NULL"
g3 = getGraph (subW)
test3=nodeData(g3)  # this is empty of data

# Strangely, this does work:
getNodeAttributeNames (subW)  

# but not this:
subW2 <- existing.CytoscapeWindow (subW,  copy.graph.from.cytoscape.to.R=TRUE)  #  error message:
#Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) : 
#  'match' requires vector arguments


Mark

messages.author: aedc8ef8f23b5716
messages.subject: Re: getAllNodeAttributes
parts:
Hi Mark,

I think this problem -- which was reported by David Reiss last week -- can be solved like this:

cw <- existing.CytoscapeWindow ('name of network goes here', copy.graph=TRUE)

getAllNode|EdgeAttributes draws data from the graphNEL (cw@graph) on the R side of things. So by copying the Cytoscape network into an R graph, which is the effect of copy.graph=TRUE, there is attribute data for the 'getAll...' function to draw from.

Sorry the error message is not more clear. I will fix that.

Cheers,

- Paul

Paul

If you see my second message to the google group, what you say below
works but not when a sub-network is created with RCy. This breaks my
workflow for the purpose of selecting sub-networks and then adding
edges. A perhaps related problem is when setLineWidthRule is used node
size and shape vizprops are lost on subnetworks; maybe because node
attributes are lost? Or because style is set back to 'default'? Or both?

I need to preserve node vizprops in sub-networks. To avoid commands
that reset the style back to 'default' I can try to set up edge rules
before adding edges as a workaround, but I don't know whether that
will work.

Mark
